skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.trigger: diagnose/debug requests and broken, throwing, failing, or slow behavior.
steps: Build a tight red-capable feedback loop
Instrument one variable at a time
Fix with a seam-correct regression test
Clean up and write a post-mortem
completion_criteria: One command already run that can go red on the exact symptom
Deterministic, fast, agent-runnable loop
Original repro and regression test pass
Debug logs and throwaway prototypes removed

skills.rationale: Retain as a read-only comparator and user/model-discoverable option; use its red-capable-loop gap to improve Spark's canonical debugger without copying it.

skills.name: tdd
skills.trigger: feature or bugfix work requested test-first, red-green-refactor, or integration tests.
steps: Agree the seams before writing tests
Run one vertical slice: red, minimal implementation, repeat
Avoid implementation-coupled, tautological, and horizontal tests
completion_criteria: Each slice has a public seam and an independent expected result
Red precedes green
No speculative implementation or unconfirmed seam

license.assessment: Not declared in frontmatter; do not infer a license.

skills.rationale: Keep external because the seam-agreement and vertical-slice rules are useful independent guidance; improve the bundled Spark canon rather than vendor this file.
